meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Viet Nam (national unitary jurisdiction; no sub-state tax or registration distinction)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid – Civil Law codified system with socialist-legality overlay; unitary single-jurisdiction corporation law
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: EU – Viet Nam Free Trade Agreement (EVFTA, in force 1 August 2020)
EU – Viet Nam Investment Protection Agreement (EVIPA, signed 30 June 2019; not yet in force)
Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership (CPTPP, in force for Viet Nam 14 January 2019)
Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership (RCEP, in force 1 January 2022)
Viet Nam – Japan Bilateral Investment Treaty (2003)
Viet Nam – Republic of Korea Bilateral Investment Treaty (2003)
Viet Nam – Netherlands Bilateral Investment Treaty (1994)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14; Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP on enterprise registration; Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14; Law on Anti-Money Laundering No. 14/2022/QH15 (effective 1 March 2023); Decree No. 19/2023/ND-CP (28 April 2023) implementing the AML Law; Circular No. 09/2023/TT-NHNN of the State Bank of Viet Nam on AML/CFT; Law on Complaints No. 02/2011/QH13 (administrative remedies).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation / Certificate of Good Standing of the foreign corporate shareholder-investor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registrar or other competent registry of the investor's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille by the home competent authority if the home state is an Apostille Contracting Party; otherwise Consular Legalization at the Embassy or Consulate of Viet Nam in the country of issue (Viet Nam is not yet a Contracting Party to the Hague Apostille Convention, so apostilles from origin states do not yet auto-operate in Viet Nam).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of the parent board resolution authorizing incorporation of the Viet Nam LLC and appointing the signatory or legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company secretary or notary public in the home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization or certified-notarial path recognized by the provincial Department of Planning and Investment; followed by notarized Vietnamese translation.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Audited financial statements of the foreign investor for the latest two years (financial capacity evidence)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Independent registered auditor in the home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization of each statement, followed by notarized Vietnamese translation; acceptance is at the discretion of the provincial DPI.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Full-color passport copies of each ultimate beneficial owner, proposed director and legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport or national ID issuing authority of the UBO's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Certified true copy by a notary in Viet Nam or by the home notary; no apostille required when the original is displayed for comparison at the Vietnamese notary office.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: UBO / PEP self-certification and AML questionnaire (PEP status declaration, source of funds, beneficial ownership chain)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Compliance officer of the advising Viet Nam licensed law firm (template administered to the UBO)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Original signature of the UBO; included in the internal KYC file; notarization of signature recommended but not mandatory.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter for the investor (optional for the Low_Risk_Standard tier)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Bank seal and signature; consular legalization when required by the receiving Vietnamese bank.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based due diligence on all UBOs, directors and legal representatives, including PEP enhanced scrutiny per Article 25 of Law No. 14/2022/QH15 and Circular No. 09/2023/TT-NHNN; pre-clearance screening against the OFAC SDN list, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU consolidated financial sanctions, UK HMT sanctions, and the State Bank of Viet Nam's domestic enforcement actions and blacklists; results must be documented in the KYC file and refreshed before any post-incorporation bank account opening.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: National Enterprise Registration Information System / National Business Registration Portal (Cổng thông tin quốc gia về đăng ký doanh nghiệp) operated by the Agency for Business Registration, Ministry of Planning and Investment – https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The official statutory name must be expressed in Vietnamese using the Latin-based Vietnamese alphabet. Articles 37–41 of the Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 and the implementing rules of Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP require the Vietnamese name to begin with the legal suffix 'Công ty TNHH'; the name may include letters A–Z, a–z, Arabic numerals and the symbols '&' and '-'; it must not be identical or confusingly similar to a name already on the National Enterprise Registry. The foreign investor's English or ESG brand may be added as a supplementary name (tên công ty bằng tiếng nước ngoài) and a shortened name; transliteration shall preserve phonetics and avoid any token resembling a state body, a licensed profession (audit, banking, insurance) or another registered enterprise.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bộ (Ministry), Thủ tướng, Chính phủ, Quốc hội, Công an, Quân đội – tokens implying a state authority
Vietnam / Việt Nam / Quốc tế / Nhà nước in combinations that falsely imply state-owned or state-affiliated status
Ngân hàng (Bank) – requires prior approval of the State Bank of Viet Nam
Chứng khoán (Securities) – requires prior license of the State Securities Commission
Bảo hiểm (Insurance) – requires prior license of the Ministry of Finance
Kiểm toán / Kế toán (Audit / Accounting) – regulated professional tokens; carbon auditing wording should use 'thẩm định' or 'đánh giá' unless a separate audit licence is obtained
Quỹ đầu tư, Sở giao dịch, Xổ số, Bệnh viện, Trường đại học – regulated sectoral tokens requiring a special-purpose licence or approval
Hợp tác xã, Tổng công ty, Chi nhánh – tokens reserved for other legal forms or requiring a corporate predicate
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the provincial DPI rejects the proposed name, the applicant receives a written notice citing the violating ground under Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP. The applicant may (i) submit a corrected dossier with a new proposed name within the statutory processing cycle (normally 3 working days) without losing the filing priority date; (ii) file a first-instance complaint with the Director of the provincial Department of Planning and Investment within 30 days of the rejection pursuant to the Law on Complaints No. 02/2011/QH13; and (iii) if the complaint is rejected or unanswered for 30 days, initiate an administrative action at the competent provincial People's Court. A further name check may be commissioned on the National Enterprise Registration Portal for a fresh 30-day informal reservation window; the initial statutory name search carries no official fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for this low-risk ISIC 7020 professional-services company subject to a physical, non-P.O.-box Vietnamese address: a serviced office or co-working space with a dedicated postcode, mail-reception function and a person available to accept service of process is acceptable to the DPI and tax authorities; the address must appear on the Enterprise Registration Certificate and be the sole official venue for statutory correspondence. The virtual-office provider must supply a lease paperwork package authorizing the LLC to use the address for registration.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk: approximately 5%–8% per annum for the first operating year at the Low_Risk_Standard tier. Triggers: DPI post-registration administrative supervision, tax desk audits and fire-safety inspections by the Provincial Police. No mandatory inspection applies for unlicensed ESG advisory entities; unannounced site visits are rare but the registered office must remain staffed during office hours as a condition of the lease and the ERC.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Preliminary name clearance search and statutory name screening report on the National Enterprise Registration Portal (including transliteration opinion)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: State fee for online search: nil; market benchmark fee for the law firm's search and opinion

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) application support and investment policy screening (foreign investor route)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: IRC state fee: free under Decree No. 31/2021/ND-CP; law-firm professional fee at prevailing market benchmark

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC) official state fee for a limited liability company
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff: 100,000 VND (approx. USD 4–5) under Circular No. 125/2020/TT-BTC

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarized Vietnamese translation of foreign corporate documents (Charter, certificate of good standing, board resolution; approx. 5 documents)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed translation company / Notary Public in Viet Nam
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark: 150,000–250,000 VND per notarized translation document

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law on Enterprise No. 59/2020/QH14 (effective 01 January 2021), notably Articles 9 (management authority), 22 (enterprise registration), 24 through 33 (enterprise registration procedure and dossiers), 39 (contents of company charter), 47 (schedule for capital contribution), and 74 through 83 (single-member limited liability company); Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14, Articles 21 through 26 and Appendix IV (conditional sectors), confirming that ISIC 7020 management consultancy is unconditioned and permits 100% foreign ownership; implementing regulations: Decree No. 01/2021/NĐ-CP on Enterprise Registration and Decree No. 31/2021/NĐ-CP detailing the Law on Investment.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Business Registration Office (Phòng Đăng Ký Kinh Doanh) of the provincial Department of Planning and Investment (Sở Kế Hoạch và Đầu Tư), operating under the Agency for Business Registration of the Ministry of Planning and Investment through the National Business Registration Portal at dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Enterprise Registration Application Dossier for establishment of a foreign-invested single-member limited liability company, headed by the standardized Enterprise Registration Certificate Application Form (Form No. 01, promulgated with Decree No. 01/2021/NĐ-CP), accompanied by the Investment Registration Certificate (IRC), the Company Charter, the List of Members, and notarized constituent documents.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum charter capital is fixed by law for ISIC 7020 management consultancy services (non-conditional sector under Appendix IV of the Law on Investment 2020); the sole member must state charter capital in the Company Charter and must fully pay in the committed capital within 90 days from issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate (Article 47, Law on Enterprise 2020), failing which the company is obliged, under the same Article, to register either a reduction of charter capital or a supplementary capital contribution within an additional statutory period. No escrow account is statutorily mandated for this service industry; for banking and investment-registration proof, the capital contribution is tracked through a dedicated Vietnamese bank account opened in the company name.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST RESOLUTION OF THE SOLE MEMBER OF [OFFICIAL COMPANY NAME] ACTING IN THE CAPACITY OF THE COMPANY OWNERSHIP BODY, DATED [DATE], AT [REGISTERED OFFICE ADDRESS]: WHEREAS the Company is being incorporated as a foreign-invested single-member limited liability company in the Socialist Republic of Vietnam under Law on Enterprise No. 59/2020/QH14; WHEREAS the Sole Member has approved the Company Charter; NOW IT IS RESOLVED UNANIMOUSLY: (1) SHARE/CAPITAL SUBSCRIPTION: the Sole Member subscribes to the whole charter capital of VND [AMOUNT IN WORDS] ([AMOUNT IN NUMBERS]) and commits to contribute and fully pay such capital no later than 90 days from the Enterprise Registration Certificate issuance date, per the attached capital contribution schedule; (2) REGISTERED OFFICE: the head office of the Company is lawfully fixed at [REGISTERED OFFICE ADDRESS, PROVINCE, VIETNAM], and the legal representative is authorized to execute and deliver the office lease, to post occupancy notices, and to register any later change of head office; (3) OFFICER APPOINTMENTS: [LEGAL REPRESENTATIVE FULL NAME], passport/ID No. [NUMBER], is appointed as the first General Director, Chairman of the Members Council and the sole legal representative of the Company, with plenary powers to represent the Company before public authorities, courts, banks, notaries, tax and customs authorities, and to sign all contracts, corporate undertakings, statutory declarations and any registration filings (including Form No. 01 and the Company Charter); [CHIEF ACCOUNTANT FULL NAME] is appointed as chief accountant responsible for accounting books and financial reporting; and the General Director and Chairman jointly are constituted as the banking signing committee, with the Company seal specimen and bank signatory cards approved; (4) COMPANY SEAL: the Company shall procure and maintain a carved seal in compliance with Article 45 of the Law on Enterprise 2020 and Decree 01/2021/NĐ-CP, and shall use the seal exclusively through the authorized legal representative; (5) INCORPORATION AUTHORIZATION: the General Director is expressly authorized to prepare, execute, notarize and submit the investment registration dossier and enterprise registration dossier to the Department of Planning and Investment, to pay registration fees and publication fees, to publish company information on the National Business Registration Portal, and to procure tax codes, e-invoices, bank accounts and any licenses necessary before the start of operations; (6) RATIFICATION AND EFFECTIVENESS: this First Resolution is unconditional, irrevocable, and effective immediately; copies may be made by banks, notaries and authorities and shall remain valid until revoked by a subsequent written resolution of the Sole Member or Members Council.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Legalization, translation and notarization of constituent documents of the foreign investor
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Consular Department of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Vietnam (legalization/apostille); Notary Public offices in the target province (usually in Hanoi or Ho Chi Minh City) for Vietnamese notarization.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Collect the investor's original Certificate of Incorporation, Certificate of Good Standing (if available), passport of the investor's legal representative and the board resolution/power of attorney authorizing incorporation in Vietnam. Have the document legalized by Vietnam's foreign mission or consular department under Decree 111/2011/NĐ-CP; then have it translated into Vietnamese by a licensed or professionally recognized translation office and notarized by a local notary public. Ensure notarized copies are made within six months of issue, with all seals and stamps legible, before inclusion in the dossiers of the Department of Planning and Investment.
required_dossiers: Original Certificate of Incorporation or business registration of the foreign investor (legalized)
Certificate of Good Standing or equivalent certificate issued by a relevant corporate registry (legalized)
Valid passport of the investor's legal representative
Board resolution or power of attorney appointing the signatory in Vietnam
Heads of terms or pre-signed office lease for the Vietnamese head office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the legalization stamp is missing or illegible, or the translation is rejected, the documents must be returned to the competent legalization authority or a certified translation office; corrections may be refilled without a new fee where the DPI query is procedural. If expiry has occurred, obtain a fresh Certificate of Good Standing or a new power of attorney.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) application for 100% foreign-owned enterprise
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Planning and Investment of the province or city of location (e.g., Hanoi DPI or Ho Chi Minh City DPI), received through the provincial investment registration window or the National Foreign Investment Information System (dautunuocngoai.gov.vn).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the investment project proposal for ISIC 7020 ESG carbon auditing and offset brokerage, confirming that the service is non-conditional. Submit the IRC dossier in Vietnamese, together with legalized investor documents, capital contribution table, capital commitment plan, office location plan and financial capacity statement. The DPI verifies the project, consults line ministries only if the sector were conditional (not the case), and issues the IRC within 15 working days for projects outside industrial parks (or within delegated authority for zones inside industrial parks). The IRC will identify the new company as a foreign-invested enterprise.
required_dossiers: Investment Registration Certificate application form (Form A.I.5 applicable to foreign investors)
Proposed investment project document (objective, capital, location, duration, environmental and workplace plan)
Legal capacity certificate of the investor (legalized and notarized constituent materials)
Financial capacity statement of the investor or confirmation of bank balance or credit line
Office location plan or memorandum of understanding for the lease
Power of attorney to the Vietnamese filing agent (if submitted through agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the DPI issues a notice requesting amendment or supplementation, the investor must respond within 10 working days from receipt of the notice (Law on Investment 2020); on non-response the application may be returned. A written explanation should correct the deficiencies, and an amended dossier may be re-submitted; decision appeals lie to the Minister of Planning and Investment or to the administrative court according to the Law on Handling of Administrative Violations 2012.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC) filing on the National Business Registration Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Business Registration Office of the provincial Department of Planning and Investment via the National Business Registration Portal (dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare Form No. 01 and the corresponding dossier under Decree 01/2021/NĐ-CP, containing the company charter, list of members (single foreign member), legal representative's notarized ID or passport, IRC, office lease, and address-notification consent of the owner. Activate the digital signature of the legal representative and e-file the dossier on the Portal, paying the small state fee electronically. The DPI must issue or return the ERC within 3 working days; if the dossier fails, the DPI provides a written notice explaining the deficiency. Upon approval, the ERC will include the enterprise code, tax code, legal form, charter capital, head office, legal representative and business lines (including ISIC 7020 services).
required_dossiers: Enterprise Registration Certificate Application Form (Form No. 01)
Investment Registration Certificate (copy notarized)
Company Charter of the single-member LLC (bilingual Vietnamese/English signature convention)
List of members (sole member) with legal capacity records
Notarized ID or passport and appointment resolution of the legal representative
Lease agreement or ownership title proof for the registered office and written consent of the lessor
Legalized and notarized constituent documents of the foreign investor
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where the DPI issues a request for additional documents or correction, the company has 7 working days to respond and remediate under Article 26 of Decree 01/2021/NĐ-CP; if the deadline passes without correction, the registration may be refused with a reasoned notice, and the applicant may re-submit a refreshed dossier or file a complaint to the Ministry of Planning and Investment or the court.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Mandatory publication of corporate registration data on the National Business Registration Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Agency for Business Registration under the Ministry of Planning and Investment by way of the National Business Registration Portal.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within 30 days of obtaining the ERC, the company must cause its incorporation information (company name, head office, legal representative, charter capital, business lines) to be posted on the National Business Registration Portal. The announcement is carried out through the online facility following the instructions on the portal, and the statutory publication fee (approximately VND 100,000) is paid electronically. The publication protects third parties in respect of the articles of incorporation and is a prerequisite for some authorities to open tax and labor records.
required_dossiers: Enterprise Registration Certificate (copy)
Publication application form generated by the National Business Registration Portal
Evidence of administrative payment (online receipt)
Charter capital confirmation for the publication format (as indicated on ERC)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the publication fails due to technical defects, contact the portal hotline and request issuance of a proof-of-submission receipt; the company may file a new publication request with the same registration data. Failure to publish exposes the company to sanctions under Decree 50/2016/NĐ-CP on administrative violations in enterprise registration; a late filing is cured by completing the publication immediately after the missed statutory term.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-incorporation administrative and banking activation: tax registration, social insurance registration, bank account opening and e-invoice readiness
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Provincial Tax Sub-Department (Chi Cục Thuế) under the General Department of Taxation; Vietnam Social Security provincial office; any licensed commercial bank chosen by the company.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Activate tax obligations with the tax authority holding the tax-code files of the new ERC by completing form 01-ĐK-TCT within 10 working days of the ERC; the tax sub-department provides a tax certificate confirming the enterprise tax code, VAT method, and CIT identification. Open a corporate capital-contribution account and operating accounts with a licensed bank, applying standard KYC. Register employees and payroll with Vietnam Social Insurance under the Law on Social Insurance 2014; draft internal labor regulations; configure the electronic-invoice solution to be activated with the tax authority under Decree 123/2020/NĐ-CP, requesting the invoice issuing certification scheme on the e-invoice portal of the General Department of Taxation.
required_dossiers: Enterprise Registration Certificate (photocopy authenticated)
Tax registration declaration form 01-ĐK-TCT
Bank account opening application and resolution of the company on signing powers
Charter capital contribution schedule and initial capital deposit evidence if available
List of employees and labor contracts signed
Legal representative's ID and the seal specimen registration card
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax authority returns the tax registration, the company has 10 days to complete the file; e-tax accounts may be re-opened electronically. If social insurance data are inconsistent, correct via electronic corrections. A missing bank confirmation is remedied by producing the bank certificate in the prescribed form.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Operational formation: e-invoice activation, internal labor rules, fire-safety self-assessment and local office environmental registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: General Department of Taxation e-invoice system (hoadondientu.gdt.gov.vn); Department of Labor, War Invalids and Social Affairs (DOLISA) for labor compliance; provincial Fire Prevention and Rescue Police for office premises; communal or urban environmental authority for waste registration.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After bank and tax configuration, activate the corporate e-invoice issuing capability in the GDT's e-invoice system, declare the price quotation, then start sequential invoice usage for the ESG-carbon consulting invoices. If the office accommodates any kitchen, wet laboratory or generator room (normally not for an advisory office), register the domestic-solid-waste contract with a licensed collector. Conduct fire-safety performance test and evacuation record per the fire police requirements applicable to the floor-space class of the office; adopt the internal labor regulation within six months from the first hiring and file it with DOLISA; maintain occupational risk assessment and health monitoring records required by the Labor Code.
required_dossiers: E-invoice activation application and issuance records
List of outputs/services subject to VAT and the price quotation
Fire-prevention installation test records and certificate of acceptance (if the building owner has not supplied a global certificate)
Internal labor regulation filing to DOLISA and social insurance records
Domestic waste collection agreement and hazardous waste registration if any small quantities of batteries or printing toner are stored
Occupational risk assessment plan and employee health surveillance plan
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If e-invoice activation is refused, submit an explanation with corrected data pursuant to the pre-acceptance review of the tax sub-department; a fire inspection deficiency is cured by the fire police issuing a remedial notice and a re-inspection within 5 working days; labor regulation filing, where returned, is corrected and re-filed by DOLISA's electronic procedure.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable for ISIC 7020: a pure advisory office business is not an industrial project and is not subject to an industrial licensing board. For voluntary climate-linked registration, the Department of Climate Change of the Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MONRE) and the Ministry of Finance serve as the regulatory counterparts under Decree 06/2022/NĐ-CP on greenhouse gas emission mitigation and ozone-layer protection.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable; management consultancy and carbon-audit advisory services are not conditional activities under Appendix IV of the Law on Investment 2020, and no separate operating or manufacturing permit is issued. When the GHG inventory and carbon offset market becomes operational, the enterprise may obtain a registration decision as an eligible GHG-inventory or audit organization from MONRE, and a carbon-intermediary registration with the Ministry of Finance or State Securities Commission only if the service crosses into regulated carbon-derivative trading.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MONRE) and the provincial Department of Natural Resources and Environment (DONRE) of the city or province of the registered office
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt from a full EIA report and from the environmental permit under Articles 25-28 of Law on Environmental Protection 2020 and Decree 08/2022/NĐ-CP, because the project is an office-based consultancy with no production lines, no industrial wastewater, and neither hazardous-waste generation nor emission sources above the statutory threshold; the project only registers its domestic solid-waste arrangements with the urban or communal environmental authority and maintains waste-transfer records.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Where any domestic wastewater is generated, the office must comply with QCVN 14:2008/BTNMT for domestic wastewater (limit for BOD5 30 mg/L, TSS 50 mg/L, coliforms 3,000 MPN/100ML for facilities connecting to receiving watercourses) or meet the sewer-system standards of the urban water authority; ambient noise under QCVN 26:2010/BTNMT (office limit 70 dBA daytime or 55 dBA night if in quiet areas) and workplace air quality under QCVN 21:2016/BYT if HVAC or generator emissions exist; hazardous waste management under Decree 08/2022, requiring that any waste whose cumulative amount exceeds 100 kg/year triggers a written notification of waste generation and transport via licensed waste transporters, while small office wastes are surrendered to licensed collectors with manifests.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Civil defense and occupational clearance for the office premises: obtain fire-protection design approval and acceptance verification from the provincial Fire Prevention and Rescue Police (Bộ Công an) under Decree 136/2020/NĐ-CP if the leased office is in a building not covered by a previously issued acceptance certificate; maintain a registered self-inspection checklist, internal fire-fighting equipment, emergency exit signs, and periodic evacuation drills; obtain a completion inspection certificate for building works from the local Department of Construction under Decree 06/2021/NĐ-CP where a new building envelope is occupied, and an occupational-safety declaration and workplace health risk assessment under Article 18 of Law on Occupational Safety and Hygiene 2015, including medical surveillance and safety lighting in the workplace.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: General Department of Taxation (Tổng cục Thuế) of the Ministry of Finance of the Socialist Republic of Viet Nam; national e-tax portal https://etaxvn.gdt.gov.vn and national electronic invoice portal https://thuedientu.gdt.gov.vn.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Under the one-stop enterprise registration mechanism, a foreign-invested LLC is issued a 13-digit Tax Identification Number (Mã số doanh nghiệp) automatically together with the Enterprise Registration Certificate by the provincial Department of Planning and Investment via the National Business Registration Portal (https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn). The LLC must then (i) activate the e-tax account at https://etaxvn.gdt.gov.vn using the legal representative's PKI digital certificate; (ii) update tax registration information using Form 01-ĐK-TCT (Circular 105/2020/TT-BTC) for any subsequent change within 10 working days; (iii) obtain a tax-authority-approved electronic invoice template registered on the Electronic Invoice Portal; and (iv) open a direct investment capital account if applicable. For an offshore ESG/carbon advisory vendor without a Vietnamese legal presence, the Vietnamese client is the withholding agent for Foreign Contractor Tax and no standalone TIN is needed unless the foreign vendor registers directly with the GDT.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation – the foreign-invested LLC is a Vietnamese tax resident subject to corporate income tax at the 20% statutory rate on worldwide income. Viet Nam does not recognize pass-through/LLC tax transparency; income is always taxed at the entity level. A Territorial_Scope carve-out applies only to non-resident foreign contractors, whose Vietnam-source income is taxed via withholding (Foreign Contractor Tax). The LLC may additionally qualify for Tax_Exempt_Zone preferential CIT rates if located in an export processing, industrial, high-tech or economic zone, but a stand-alone ESG consulting LLC has no automatic exemption.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Viet Nam does not operate a US-style check-the-box or hybrid mismatch election regime. The available statutory elections are: (i) VAT accounting method election: the deduction (credit) method is mandatory once annual revenue equals or exceeds VND 1 billion; a small taxpayer may elect the direct method while below that threshold; (ii) accounting currency and fiscal year election for the CIT file; (iii) investment-incentive elections recorded on the Investment Registration Certificate (preferential rates, tax holidays, import duty exemptions); (iv) consolidated transfer pricing documentation election under Decree 132/2020/ND-CP for the economic-statistical analysis of related-party services; and (v) optional micro-enterprise simplified accounting treatment. Hybrid mismatch adjustments are not available as an election; Viet Nam's interest-limitation rules follow the BEPS approach with no elective de-minimis for related-party interest.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT; thuế giá trị gia tăng) on goods and services supplied in Viet Nam, including imports and deemed services; standard rate is 10% (a temporary reduced 8% rate applies only to a statutory list of goods/services not covering ESG carbon audit and offset brokerage).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VND 1,000,000,000 (approximately USD 43,000) of annual turnover from taxable supplies triggers mandatory VAT registration and the deduction method; registration is compulsory irrespective of turnover for any entity liable to corporate income tax or Foreign Contractor Tax, including foreign-invested LLCs commencing activities in Viet Nam.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Since 1 July 2022 all Vietnamese taxpayers must issue electronic invoices under Decree No. 123/2020/ND-CP and Circular No. 78/2021/TT-BTC. An LLC using the deduction method must issue invoices bearing the seller's e-certificate in standardized XML and transmit every invoice data file to the General Department of Taxation's e-invoice portal (https://thuedientu.gdt.gov.vn) in near-real-time to obtain an exclusive tax-authority transaction code (coded e-invoice) before delivery to the client; service invoices must be issued at the moment of completion and transmitted within the prescribed deadline. Non-coded e-invoices are permitted only for qualifying transactions and require summary transmission within 1 working day. The GDT portal exposes an API enabling real-time fiscal clearance and risk profiling; the tax authority can block issuance of invalid invoices and trigger automatic desk audits. E-invoice hardcopy conversion and digital stamping are not permitted substitutes.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A 0% VAT rate applies to exported goods, goods and services supplied to export processing enterprises, and exported services. For ESG/carbon footprint audit and offset brokerage, the service must (i) be contractually performed for a foreign organization or individual; (ii) be actually rendered and consumed outside Viet Nam (domestic consumption, even under a foreign contract, is excluded); (iii) be paid for in convertible foreign currency from abroad (bank transfer evidence required); (iv) meet the Article 9.1 Circular No. 219/2013/TT-BTC documentation test, including a written service contract, a 0% VAT invoice, evidence of foreign-client non-residence and offshore use, and, for offset brokerage, carbon-credit registry transaction reports. Services that involve on-site data collection in Viet Nam or provide benefits to a Vietnamese entity remain subject to 10% VAT unless the entirety of the output is consumed outside Viet Nam.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Export service contract (or purchase order) expressly identifying the foreign counterparty and stipulating that the ESG carbon auditing/offset brokerage output is consumed entirely outside Viet Nam
Coded 0% VAT e-invoice and, for any tangible deliverables or equipment embedded in the service, a Customs Export Declaration with the electronic customs seal
Foreign-currency inward remittance certificate or SWIFT MT103 bank statement evidencing actual payment received from the non-resident client abroad

Notarized certificate of non-residence and offshore consumption, including the foreign client's tax-residency evidence, work-paper/time records demonstrating Vietnam-offshore performance, and carbon registry transaction reports for offset brokerage
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Zero-rating and refund claims are high-risk targets of the General Department of Taxation's export-audit programme; the GDT cross-matches e-invoice data, customs declarations, bank FX dashboards, and foreign-client residency evidence. False declarations (fictitious export contracts, circular or round-trip payments, invoices without overseas consumption) expose the LLC to: (i) denial of the VAT refund and mandatory prospective clawback of previously credited input VAT, compounded with late-payment interest of 0.02% per day on underpaid VAT; (ii) administrative fines under Decree No. 125/2020/ND-CP of 1 time the under-declared tax for negligent underestimation and 1.5 to 2.5 times the evaded amount for intentional evasion; (iii) suspension or revocation of the e-invoice code authorization and of the refund entitlement; and (iv) criminal liability under Article 200 of the Penal Code 2015 (amended 2017) where evasion exceeds VND 100,000,000, with fines up to VND 4,500,000,000 and imprisonment of up to 12 years for the most serious export-VAT fraud, in addition to retrospective assessment of all years under the 5-year audit window and collection of dunning penalties.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Bank of Vietnam (SBV), exercising foreign exchange administration powers through the Foreign Exchange Control Department and monetary authority under the Law on the State Bank of Vietnam, the Ordinance on Foreign Exchange, and Circular No. 15/2015/TT-NHNN. SBV is the sole approving authority for licensing credit institutions that may clear international payments and hold foreign currency on behalf of Vietnamese residents.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vietnamese Dong (VND) is convertible on the current account for legitimate trade and service transactions, including cross-border corporate advisory services related to ESG carbon audit. Capital-account convertibility is restricted and requires a documented underlying FDI contribution, intra-company loan, or registered investment project. Profit remittances by a foreign-invested LLC are permitted on an annual basis after the company completes audited financial statements and satisfies all corporate income tax, VAT, and other statutory obligations; the distribution must be evidenced by the applicable tax revenue declaration, an independent auditor's report, and minutes of the member's meeting. The residual profits may be converted and transferred abroad by a commercial bank acting as a licensed agent. In practice, capital-account transactions face detailed KYC, purpose-code, and SBV electronic reporting requirements, and there is no active offshore VND foreign-exchange market, meaning that conversion timing and USD/EUR position-taking are strictly limited by the onshore interbank rate and the exchange-rate band regulated by SBV.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under Circular No. 15/2015/TT-NHNN and SBV administrative practice, all export proceeds derived from the provision of services, including ESG advisory, carbon audit, and offset brokerage, must be credited to a foreign-currency account at a licensed Vietnamese bank within 15 calendar days from the date the payment is received. There is no automatic and unconditional mandatory surrender-to-VND requirement for service exporters; however, the bank may require conversion for repayment of VND debts if so triggered under the loan documentation, and the use of retained foreign currency is subject to prior declaration and must be monetized in a purpose-compliant manner. Exporters are obliged to upload the underlying sale contract, service invoice, and SWIFT credit advice to the bank for receipt verification and SBV reporting, failing which the remittance will be held in a suspense account and may be rejected if the documentary trail is insufficient.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) / Operational VND and Foreign-Currency Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium with hard regulatory limits. Offshore digital EMI providers such as Wise Business, Airwallex, and Revolut can serve as ancillary collection accounts for USD/EUR receipts from non-Vietnamese clients, but they cannot act as a licensed banking venue for indie Vietnamese entity because they lack an SBV credit-institution license and are not admitted to the domestic VND interbank clearing system. All FDI equity contributions, statutory tax payments, and the main operational clearing for salary and vendor settlement in Vietnam must be executed through a licensed Vietnamese bank. An offshore EMI account may raise SBV reputational risk if used to present false payment locality or to conceal Vietnamese-source revenue, so it should be limited strictly to foreign-source cash sweeps feeding into the licensed Vietnamese bank and never used for domestic collections or tax deposits.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Directors of a foreign-invested LLC must satisfy the physical-presence requirement under the Law on Anti-Money Laundering No. 2022, which requires customer due diligence and identification of the ultimate beneficial owner. In practice, Vietnamese banks require that at least one director or a formally authorized representative appear in person at the branch for the initial account-opening interview, or alternatively that a back-to-back power of attorney is legalized by the Vietnamese diplomatic mission in the director's home country followed by a physical visit from the authorized officer. Remote opening has been expanding in Vietnam for individual e-KYC, but corporate accounts generally trigger a mandatory face-to-face sign-off for the appointment of authorized signatories and for mutation of signature cards. Best practice for this ESG carbon advisory LLC is for the compliance officer and the designated signatory to travel to Ho Chi Minh City or Hanoi for the onboarding interview and to present original corporate certificates, passport copies, and board resolution approving the bank mandate.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate beneficial owner cannot be transparently traced due to multi-holding in carbon-offset project holding and separate brokerage SPVs.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full corporate organizational chart showing each layer of ownership; certified LLC charter, Investment Registration Certificate, Enterprise Registration Certificate; passport pages and permanent address proof of every individual holding greater than 25% equity; signed UBO declaration in the bank's required form; board resolution recognising the appointed bank signatories and confirming the economic substance of each vehicle.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Regulatory and reputational risk of the commercial description 'carbon offset brokerage' being viewed as a disguised crypto or tokenized carbon-credit operation.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Verified registry evidence of the project's serialized carbon credits from internationally recognized standards such as Verra (VCS) or Gold Standard; independent third-party audit report confirming the project's additionality and emission reduction methodology; a template carbon-credit purchase and resale contract clearly denominating the instruments as in-kind environmental commodities rather than crypto securities; a narrative explaining compliance with the Vietnamese Law on Environmental Protection and the country's Nationally Determined Contribution where applicable.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume inbound remittances from legally non-transparent offshore clients in tax-advantaged jurisdictions inconsistent with the LLC's commercial model.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed cross-border service agreements with each material client; client KYC profile with QCEB or equivalent due diligence; detailed commercial invoices referencing the ESG audit scope; evidence that the underlying audit certificates are issued in the name of the Vietnamese entity; six to twelve months of prior bank statements to demonstrate a normal growth trajectory; source-of-funds certification signed by a senior officer of the counterparty bank.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Physical-presence mismatch where a remote foreign director operates the LLC only by proxy and the bank identifies a non-arm's-length power-of-attorney arrangement.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Correctly legalized power of attorney issued by the director with a verified Vietnamese consular stamp; copy of the director's passport and visa stamp evidencing at least one in-person business visit; proof of effective management such as a lease agreement for a local advisory office, payroll records for compliance personnel in Vietnam, and corporate mailbox/phone reconciliation; a detailed explanation of the remote operating model provided to the bank's AML officer during the mandatory interview.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Each equity capital contribution must be routed by SWIFT MT103 from the offshore subscribing shareholder to the VN LLC's Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) held at the licensed Vietnamese bank. The wire must carry the remitter's reference to the Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) number and clearly state the purpose as 'contribution of charter capital to a foreign-invested enterprise' in accordance with the BOP classification used by SBV. After receiving the inward credit, the bank automatically generates the foreign-exchange entry and submits the mandatory SBV electronic report within the standard regulatory window of eight working days. The receiving bank cross-references the incoming amount against the charter-capital amortization schedule defined on the ERC and, at the instruction of the LLC, converts the foreign currency to VND at the SBV-listed rate or retains it in a foreign-currency account to meet future operational disbursements. For non-charter capital intra-group cash needs, the LLC must separately register an offshore commercial loan or SBV-permitted borrowing agreement, issue a credit facility note, and receive such funds through a second DICA account in compliance with cross-border loan registration requirements.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound payments for trade settlement and service disbursement are executed primarily through SWIFT MT103 messages on the operating bank's system, which may be batched with US dollar payables for counterparties in countries without correspondent restrictions. The LLC must attach to each payment a purpose code that matches the underlying transaction, such as payment for environmental auditing services or purchase of verified carbon credits. Commercial Letters of Credit (LC) are permissible for settlement of physical commodities if the transaction is structured through an LC at sight or a usance LC; for the ESG carbon-offset model, however, LC usage is generally unnecessary and would be used only when a buyer requires documentary export security, in which case the LLC may add a confirmation of the LC to strengthen commitment. All outbound disbursements require validation of the counterparty against SBV sanctions lists, the issuance of a Vietnamese VAT/electronic invoice if the service is treated as taxable supply, and the completion of an outbound FX form; the bank will typically freeze settlement if the LLC cannot provide invoicing, contract, or tax filing evidence.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore FX forwards with a maximum tenor of 365 days from trade date, available for hedging the LLC's underlying export receivables and import payables that are supported by written commercial contracts and a registration with the issuing licensed bank.

FX swaps and currency swaps concluded with a licensed Vietnamese bank, used to convert VND receivables into USD or EUR for cross-border debt service or to match systematic current-account flows where the underlying transactions are genuine and verifiable.

FX options concluded with a licensed bank for prudent hedging of forecast revenue streams, subject to the standard SBV requirement that the option exposure be supported by real underlying commercial transactions and not entered into for speculative purposes.

Offshore Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) are not permitted to be entered into by Vietnamese onshore residents as speculative instrument; if counterparyt banks offer NDF-like arrangements offshore, the LLC must refuse them because doing so will create unlicensed FX trading and SBV penalties. Hedging is therefore limited to deliverable onshore instruments with a documented current-account, trade, or investment underlying.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Enterprise Report (Báo cáo tình hình doanh nghiệp) submitted through the National Business Registration Portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI), Ministry of Planning and Investment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after the fiscal year end; for calendar-year companies, no later than 31 March of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines under Decree No. 122/2021/ND-CP ranging from VND 10,000,000 to VND 20,000,000; persistent non-reporting by an inactive enterprise may result in administrative cancellation of enterprise registration and strike-off from the national business registry.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Finalization Return (Tờ khai quyết toán thuế TNDN) and supporting schedules
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Department of Taxation via the electronic tax filing portal, and Local Tax Authority
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days from the end of the fiscal year; for calendar-year taxpayers, no later than 31 March of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-submission penalties under Decree No. 125/2020/ND-CP up to VND 25,000,000; additional late-payment interest applied at 0.03% per day on outstanding tax liabilities; continued failure may trigger tax coercion measures and, where tax obligations remain unresolved, enterprise registration revocation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Audited Financial Statements (Báo cáo tài chính năm) for foreign-invested LLCs
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Local Tax Authority, Provincial Department of Planning and Investment, and General Statistics Office in accordance with applicable law
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after fiscal year end; for calendar-year entities, no later than 31 March of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines under Decree No. 41/2018/ND-CP on accounting violations, up to VND 60,000,000 for late or non-submission; recurring failure to file financial statements may trigger audit and tax penalties and indirectly contribute to strike-off procedures.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Annual independent audit is compulsory for foreign-invested enterprises, including LLCs with non-resident ownership, regardless of size. Mandatory audit also applies to public-interest companies, state-owned enterprises, credit institutions, insurance and securities firms, and parent companies of consolidated groups. Domestic non-foreign-invested small LLCs may be exempt from mandatory audit but must still prepare and file unaudited financial statements in accordance with Vietnamese law.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Vietnam Accounting Standards (VAS) applied under the Law on Accounting No. 88/2015/QH13, Decree No. 174/2016/ND-CP, and Circular No. 200/2014/TT-BTC. IFRS is permissible for consolidated reporting by approved listed or large parent entities under Ministry of Finance guidelines, but statutory stand-alone financial statements must remain in VAS.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Vietnam does not maintain a separate annual UBO confirmation filing for LLCs. A foreign-invested LLC must accurately reflect the current shareholder and member structure in its annual enterprise report, update the member registry within 10 days of any share transfer or ownership change, and maintain UBO-related records on file for AML due diligence under Decree No. 11/2023/ND-CP. No separate registry submission of beneficial ownership data is required solely for annual maintenance purposes.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Danh sách thành viên)
Register of Legal Representatives and Directors

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No automatic CIT holiday for ESG carbon auditing or offset brokerage because ISIC 7020 management consultancy is not expressly listed as a preferential sector. Preferential rates may be available only for project-specific circumstances, such as location in eligible industrial zones, high-technology parks, or areas with difficult socio-economic conditions, and then typically only for newly established projects under Law on Corporate Income Tax No. 14/2008/QH12 (amended). A qualified new investment may obtain a 10% rate for 15 years, CIT exemption for up to 4 years and 50% reduction for up to 9 years, but such incentives require specific approval and are not presumed for a carbon accounting advisory business.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 03/TNDN (annual CIT finalization return) and Form 01/TNDN (quarterly provisional tax payment declaration) filed electronically via the eTax Vietnam portal (etaxvn.gdt.gov.vn) using a licensed digital signature and registered enterprise tax account.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual finalization plus quarterly provisional remittances
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The annual CIT finalization return must be filed no later than the 90th day after the end of the fiscal year. Quarterly provisional CIT declarations and payments are due no later than the 30th day after the end of each quarter, with the final quarter reconciled in the annual finalization.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax identification number, legal name in Vietnamese, legal representative, registered address, fiscal year period, and ISIC activity code. For this LLC the business code is ISIC 7020 and the commercial model is corporate Scope 1-3 carbon footprint auditing and offset brokerage.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The foreign-invested LLC files under its own Vietnamese tax identification number. No consolidated or separate non-resident CIT return is filed by the overseas parent for the LLC; the legal representative of the Vietnamese entity certifies the return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: All revenue from carbon auditing, ESG advisory, offset brokerage commissions, subscription-based carbon accounting services, and any other taxable supplies. Revenue includes both Vietnam-source and offshore-source income attributable to the Vietnam LLC.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The form must include worldwide income of the Vietnamese resident LLC. If a tax treaty reduces Vietnam-source income, the reduction must be supported by a TRC and detailed reconciliation attached to the finalization return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Allowable deductions: documented employee salaries, lease payments, software subscriptions, audit and verification costs, third-party carbon registry charges, training costs, depreciation, and arm's-length related-party fees supported by transfer pricing documentation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident parent company allocations such as management fees, royalties, or shared service charges are deductible only if the Vietnam LLC can demonstrate actual benefit, valid invoicing, and compliance with Decree 132/2020 transfer pricing rules. Unsupported allocations are disallowed and recharacterized.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line B3 - Taxable Income and Loss Carryforward
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computation of adjusted taxable income after deducting directly attributable expenditure, exempt income, and loss carryforward. Losses may be carried forward for no more than 5 consecutive years from the year incurred.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The foreign investor cannot claim the LLC's losses against its own home-country income. Loss carryforward must be evidenced by prior year CIT finalization returns and tax authority records.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line C1-C4 - CIT Payable, Incentives, Foreign Tax Credits
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Calculation of statutory CIT at 20%, application of any available preferential rates, deduction of income tax already paid abroad, and final tax payable or refundable for the year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If treaty relief is claimed on Vietnam-source royalties, interest, or other passive income, attach the TRC, a Vietnamese translation if required, and a detailed treaty position. The Vietnam LLC must still pay the full 20% CIT on business profits; DTA relief applies only to withholdings on cross-border payments and is not a general CIT exemption.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of the annual CIT finalization is subject to administrative fines under Decree 125/2020/ND-CP ranging from warning levels for very short delays up to VND 25 million for serious delays. Late tax payment interest accrues at 0.03% per day on the outstanding tax amount. Failure to file for a prolonged period allows tax authorities to issue an administrative assessment and may attract criminal tax evasion penalties if intentional evasion is established.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: Under Vietnamese domestic law, dividends or profit remittances paid by a Vietnamese limited liability company to a foreign shareholder are not subject to a separate dividend withholding tax. The foreign investor may remit after-tax profits only after the CIT finalization return has been accepted, the financial statements have been audited in accordance with Vietnamese law, and all corporate tax obligations have been settled.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Because Vietnam does not impose dividend withholding tax on profit remittances, DTA dividend relief is generally not required in a straightforward shareholder distribution. For any Vietnam-source passive payment that is subject to Foreign Contractor Tax, the payor must submit a DTA application through eTax, attach the foreign shareholder's Tax Residency Certificate issued by the residence country tax authority, provide a notarized Vietnamese translation if not in Vietnamese or English, and retain evidence of the payment flow. Vietnam's tax authority applies the treaty only if the recipient is the beneficial owner and meets any limitation-on-benefits or substance tests.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalty payments to non-residents are generally subject to Foreign Contractor Tax under Circular 103/2014/TT-BTC at a statutory CIT withholding rate of 10% on gross royalties; the applicable DTA may reduce the rate, frequently to 5-10% depending on the treaty and nature of the intellectual property. Interest payments to non-resident lenders are generally subject to a statutory CIT withholding rate of 5%, commonly reduced under Vietnamese tax treaties to 0-7.5% depending on the treaty, beneficial ownership, and whether the lender is a bank or an unrelated financial institution. Interest is not subject to Vietnamese VAT, but royalties may also attract VAT consequences unless zero-rated or treaty-protected.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File and Master File are mandatory if the Vietnamese enterprise has related-party transactions and meets at least one of the following thresholds under Decree 132/2020/ND-CP: total revenue from all activities in the tax period reaches VND 50 billion or the aggregate value of related-party transactions reaches VND 30 billion. Country-by-Country Report obligations apply to a Vietnamese constituent entity when the ultimate parent group has consolidated revenue of at least VND 18,000 billion and the Vietnamese group meets the additional thresholds set out in Decree 132/2020/ND-CP.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vietnam does not operate a standalone Economic Substance Regulations regime comparable to common law DTA gateways, but substance-over-form principles are embedded in the Law on Tax Administration 38/2019/QH14, Decree 132/2020/ND-CP, and the General Anti-Avoidance Rules. For this ESG carbon accounting and offset brokerage LLC, the tax authority may disregard transactions or structures lacking real economic substance, deny treaty benefits to shell arrangements, recharacterize artificial transfer pricing, and require that the Vietnam entity demonstrate actual staff, office premises, management decision-making, and operational capacity commensurate with the income booked.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately failing to invoice offshore carbon audit clients through the Vietnamese LLC, directing fees to a related Hong Kong or Singapore entity while the substantive services are performed in Vietnam, omitting cash receipts, or recording carbon offset brokerage commissions as non-taxable gifts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Reassessment of understated CIT and VAT, late payment interest at 0.03% per day, administrative penalties of one to three times the under-declared tax amount, and criminal prosecution under Article 200 of the Criminal Code 2015 (as amended) with fines up to VND 4.5 billion and imprisonment of up to 7 years for serious intentional evasion.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The legal representative, general director, or compliance director who signed false tax returns may be personally liable for civil restitution, may be prohibited from leaving Vietnam through temporary exit suspension, and may face criminal imprisonment if the evasion is attributable to knowing direction.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the Vietnam LLC as a booking entity with no physical office, no substantive employees, nominee shareholders, and a mailbox address while claiming CIT incentives or DTA benefits for carbon credit brokerage activities that are in reality managed and performed from another jurisdiction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Tax authorities may disregard the legal form, reattribute income to the true controlling party, deny CIT incentives and treaty benefits, impose reassessment penalties, and recommend revocation of enterprise registration under the Law on Enterprises for falsified incorporation declarations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Nominee directors and the factual controller may be jointly liable for unpaid taxes and penalties; criminal charges for fraud or tax evasion can attach where the shell structure was erected solely to mislead Vietnamese tax authorities.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Paying inflated management fees, software license charges, or carbon-offset referral commissions to a non-resident related company, or failing to prepare a Local File, Master File, or benchmark study despite exceeding the VND 50 billion revenue or VND 30 billion related-party transaction thresholds.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vietnam tax authorities may make an arm's-length adjustment by recharacterizing the actual transaction, disallow non-deductible payments, impose late payment interest, and issue penalties for inaccurate declarations. Administrative penalties for transfer pricing documentation failures are separate from underpayment penalties and may be combined with criminal penalties if the mispricing is fraudulent.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly signed or procured related-party contracts without economic justification can be personally assessed for resulting tax shortfalls in the context of civil restitution; criminal liability arises where the transfer pricing scheme amounts to tax evasion.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Remitting dividends or shareholder distributions before the annual CIT finalization is filed, before audited financial statements are issued, or repackaging in-substance profit distributions as deductible service fees to the foreign parent to avoid the audited remittance procedure.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The State Bank of Vietnam may impose foreign exchange penalties; the tax authority may recharacterize the disguised service fee as a dividend, disallow the deduction, assess 20% CIT plus late payment interest, and impose administrative fines for incorrect invoicing. Criminal tax evasion sanctions apply where the disguise is intentional.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The signing director and the foreign parent's local representative may be liable for the illegal foreign exchange remittance and for the tax consequences; exit suspension may be applied until the full tax liability is settled.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML and Payments Facilitation for Carbon Offset Fraud
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Receiving Swift and wire transfer payments for carbon offsets that are fictitious, double-counted, or connected to sanctioned counterparties, while the LLC ignores beneficial ownership red flags, fails to conduct basic due diligence, or uses low-risk type descriptors to avoid AML scrutiny.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Law on Anti-Money Laundering 2022, designated entities must report suspicious transactions to the State Bank of Vietnam and maintain customer due diligence records; violations attract administrative fines, suspension of certain activities, and criminal liability under Article 324 of the Criminal Code for money laundering if proceeds of another crime are knowingly processed.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers may face personal criminal liability for knowingly allowing the LLC to be used as a conduit for fraudulent carbon credits or proceeds of illegal activity; imprisonment terms for money laundering facilitation can be severe, and directors may also be disqualified from serving as corporate officers.
